values.note: 2026 season: opening day May 8, closing day October 11.

season.source: https://riversbendrvresort.com/ ('Opening Day May 08, 2026', 'Closing Day October 11, 2026'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://riversbendrvresort.com/ ('Choose from full hook up, water & electric or our popular Riverfront water & electric') + Firefly site classes ('Back-in Full Hook-up Site', 'Pull-thru RV Full Hookup Site', 'Pull-thru RV Site Water & Electric'), read 2026-10-22. Amperage not stated.

values.note: Back-in, pull-in and large pull-through sites: full hook-up, water & electric, riverfront water & electric and 'Waterfront Premium'; also seasonal classes (interior, interior canal/dock, waterfront), tent sites, rental cabins and campers.

sites.source: https://riversbendrvresort.com/ ('We have back-in, pull-in, and large pull-thru sites available') + Firefly site classes (Back-in Full Hook-up Site, Back-in Water/Electric, Big Rigs, Drive-In RV Site (Class A or C), Pull-thru RV Full Hookup Site, Pull-thru RV Site Water & Electric, Waterfront Premium, Seasonal Interior, Seasonal Interior Canal/ Dock, Seasonal Waterfront), read 2026-10-22. The stored ~140-site count came from note prose and no operator page states one, so it is cleared.

values.note: Hot showers, a dog park, playground and lending library; camp store with snacks, supplies, firewood, ice and bike rentals. The 2026 home page says '***LAUNDRY FACILITY IS CLOSED***'.

facilities.source: https://riversbendrvresort.com/ ('Hot showers, sparkling bathrooms ... Our Camp store offers snacks, supplies, firewood, ice and bike rentals'; '***LAUNDRY FACILITY IS CLOSED***'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Online through the operator's Firefly page; big rigs and longer stays by phone (906-779-1171). Check-in 1pm for sites, check-out 11am.

booking.source: https://riversbendrvresort.com/ ('BOOK NOW' -> Firefly; 'Check-in for campsites 1PM', 'Check-out time is 11AM') + Firefly ('Do you have a Big Rig? Are you wanting a longer stay? ... Please call us anytime at (906) 779-1171'), read 2026-10-22

note: On the Menominee River just north of Iron Mountain off US 2, beside the Menominee River Trail Bridge to Wisconsin, with rows of sites south of the river; UTV Route A starts at the campground. Rental cabins and campers. --Claude
summary: Operator home page live (phone 906-779-1171 matches; Google Maps open, 4.4 stars / 233 reviews). Changed season to the 2026 dates May 8 - Oct 11; confirmed water/sewer and pull-throughs, showers, camp store; added Firefly booking link and notes. The rates page now sits behind a human check, so the recorded rates ($45 W/E, $50-55 full hookup, $60 riverview; read 2026-10-16) stand; base $45 is under US$50. Cleared the ~140 site count (no operator figure). Note: dropped the rates, the RV Life line and the site count. Seasonal share: the engine lists three seasonal classes beside the nightly ones and a review mentions permanent campers; no share is published. Nearest gateway none needed (base under the line).
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead: the operator offers 'our popular Riverfront water & electric' sites and Firefly has a 'Waterfront Premium' class; a review of site 99 says 'right on the river ... private steps to a small dock'. The entry is 'riverview'.

Long-stay character: Firefly lists 'Seasonal Interior', 'Seasonal Interior Canal/ Dock' and 'Seasonal Waterfront' classes and a review mentions 'the permanent campers'; the seasonal share is not published. Nightly rates and an online engine are posted, so test 2 passes.
